name: The Grocery Store
source:
Nora, time for you to meet Ren! Dinner’s at our place tonight. Let’s shop for ingredients – onions are always a safe pick...

诺拉，是时候见见雷恩了！晚上在我们家吃晚饭。让我们购买食材吧——洋葱总是一个安全的选择……
